text.style: font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 7.5px; fill: rgb(108, 117, 125); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Published rows transcribed from Hu et al., CKA-RL, NeurIPS 2025, Table 1: mean over 10 seeds, ± standard deviation. Higher is better throughout; bold is the best in each
column. Published rows are sorted by their own Average performance. Baseline is excluded from the forward-transfer best, because forward transfer is defined
against Baseline's own curve, so its 0.0000 is the reference rather than a result.
† Ours' Average is over SpaceInvaders and Freeway only, not the three environments the column above it spans, so the two are not comparable: Meta-World is
the low-scoring environment for every method, and omitting it raises the mean. Ours is therefore placed at the rank it earns on SpaceInvaders and Freeway, the
two environments both sides have, rather than by the daggered number itself.
— Ours is seed 0 only, so it has no standard deviation, and its Meta-World run is still going. Ours also has live past-task environment access, which no baseline
has, and uses over 2× the frames per task. Table 1 measures plasticity; ours' retention advantage shows in Table 3.
